verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਕੀਤੇ ਨੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: karataa purakh na chetio keete no karataa kar jaanai|

en.bdb: O man, you have not remembered the creator and have accepted the created as your creator.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਿ ਭਤਾਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤੁ ਪੋਤਾ ਪਿਉ ਦਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: naar bhataar piaar kar put potaa piau dhaadh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Getting engrossed in wife or husband you have further created relationships of son, grandson, father and grandfather.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੀਆ ਭੈਣਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਸਨਿ ਰੁਸਨਿ ਸਾਕ ਬਬਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: dheeaa bhainaa maan kar tusan rusan saak babaanai|

en.bdb: Daughters and sisters proudly become happy or annoyed and such is the case of all relatives.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰ ਪੀਹਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੇ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: saahur peehar naanake paravaarai saadhaar dhin(g)aanai|

en.bdb: All other relation's such as the house of father-in-law, one's mother's house, the house of the maternal uncles and other relations of the family are disdainful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੰਚਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: chaj achaar veechaar vich pa(n)chaa a(n)dhar pat paravaanai|

en.bdb: If conduct and thoughts are civilised, one gets honour before the high ups of the society.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)t kaal jam jaal vich saathee koi na hoi sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: However, at the end, when caught up in the web of death, no companion takes notice of the person.
Bereft of the grace of the perfect Guru, all persons become scared of death.
